\begin{example} \end{example}[Unconstrained evolution of the Harnack quadratic] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0306 ↗ thm:chow-ii-harnack-quadratic-evolution 1. ch15:15.21\group Harnack Evolution Equations

For arbitrary space-time extensions of $U,W$, the evolution of $Q$ is the formula of Theorem 4 plus the product-rule terms obtained from the differences between their actual derivatives and the four prescribed derivatives in that theorem. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch Apply the product rule to each occurrence of $U$ and $W$. Subtract and add the four prescribed derivatives. The added terms reproduce the theorem; linearity of first derivatives and of $\nabla _t-\Delta $ leaves exactly the stated correction terms.

□
